parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all internal and external components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses the internal washing system, and ensures the appliance remains stable during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is a large stainless steel panel that seals the washing compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior for loading and unloading dishes and seals tightly to prevent water leakage during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates downward on hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and contains buttons and indicators for operating the dishwasher.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to select washing modes, start or stop cycles, and monitor the dishwasher’s status.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons move slightly when pressed, but the panel itself remains fixed.
